title: Designing /sync-docs: A Cross-Project Knowledge Base for Claude Code
title_zh: 设计 /sync-docs：给 Claude Code 做一个跨项目知识库
summary: A Claude Code slash command I designed to turn 311 scattered markdowns across 30+ projects into one cross-session memory file. The design decisions: what to deduplicate, how to pick a canonical copy, why context.md is capped at 2000 lines, why staleness is 90 days.
summary_zh: 我为 Claude Code 写的一个 slash command，把 30+ 项目里 311 份散落的 markdown 归成一个跨 session 记忆文件。这篇记录设计决策：去重规则、canonical 文件怎么选、为什么 context.md 封顶 2000 行、为什么 staleness 定在 90 天。

title: AI Agent Architecture Deep Dive
title_zh: AI Agent 架构深度解析
summary: How to build a tool-calling AI agent with Claude CLI: streaming, tool loops, context management, and SDK migration paths.
summary_zh: 用 Claude CLI 搭一个会调用工具的 AI agent：流式输出、工具循环、上下文管理，以及 SDK 迁移路径。

title: Spec-Kit: Iteration, Planning, and TDD Notes
title_zh: Spec-Kit：迭代、计划与 TDD 笔记
summary: How to rerun plans, write tests first, and keep SpecKit iterations traceable.
summary_zh: 怎么重跑 plan、怎么先写测试、怎么让 SpecKit 的每次迭代都可追溯。

title: NVIDIA AI Infrastructure Research Report
title_zh: NVIDIA AI 基础设施研究报告
summary: Rack-scale GB200 NVL72, cluster archetypes, deployment paths, costs, and supply chain.
summary_zh: 机架级 GB200 NVL72、集群形态、部署路径、成本与供应链。

title: SniperBot: Zero to One (Part 1)
summary: How we built a real-time Twitter sniper bot with AI, end to end, for non-coders.
summary_zh: 我们怎么从零开始用 AI 搭一个实时 Twitter 狙击机器人，端到端，写给没编程基础的人。
